CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a snap zoom in followed by a settle on a 100mm macro, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill; grade as a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
